data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 站台前的路线图
data.description: 车站墙上的路线图很大。她拿着车票对照站名，确认自己该乘哪一班车。
data.action: standing before a route map and holding a train ticket
data.promptProse: Standing on an open-air commuter railway platform under an overcast sky, Bazett studies a detailed transit wall map with a folded ticket in hand. Commuter trains rumble past on adjacent tracks, with platform signage, baggage lockers, and the industrial iron architecture of the station framing her alert, mission-ready presence.
